title: Data skill seeds.md still says a seeded roll-up value is stored as written
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibwJEh7hMPPvagWM1g7

## Problem

`skills/objectstack-data/references/seeds.md` lines 146-147 tell metadata authors: "⛔ Never seed the roll-up: a seeded `amount_paid` is stored as written, and a cap on payments refuses those it counts."

PR #36118 (card #35655, ruling D) changes that behaviour: the seed loader drops a value written for a summary (roll-up) field, never stores it, and reports the dropped keys through the per-dataset warn notice. Once #36118 merges, the skill's reason is false. The rule itself ("never seed the roll-up") still holds, but the stated consequence does not.

## Who hits it

An AI author building an app with the data skill reads this passage when it writes seed data for an object with a roll-up. With the old wording it learns the wrong model (that the value lands and later trips a validation cap). It may then write workarounds for a failure that no longer happens, or misread the new warn notice.

## What to change

Rewrite seeds.md:146-147 to say that a value seeded into a summary field is dropped with a warn notice, and that the roll-up is computed from the child rows. Keep the record-order point about rules reading a parent roll-up. Check the data skill's evals that exercise seeding roll-ups, and update them to match.

## Order

Land after PR #36118 merges. The skill text must describe shipped behaviour.

Filed by data seat 7 area d7-B as the `Skills-docs:` follow-up that PR #36118 owes. Triage routes it (expected `domain:skills`).
